text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The end of the year. I hear that in the west, it's a time people spend quietly with their family. However…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A quiet winter holiday… with just the two of us…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That's… how it usually is, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since we're always spending quiet time together, it's not especially significant for us. So this time, we head out for dinner.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That roast dinner… was really delicious. The sourness of the cranberries was a nice touch…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um… Should we order some more gingerbread? Also…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The other desserts on the menu look beautiful… Could we get some of those too?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Is there… something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, um… It is… normal, though…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I always had Manhattan Cafe down as the gloomy type, but having dinner with her today, I don't really get that impression.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maybe she's changed during our time together. Or perhaps I'm only just seeing her true nature now.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Have you ever been to Manhattan?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's a place that shares my name… I've never been there myself, though…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Visiting Manhattan, covered in a blanket of snow… That's a little dream of mine…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I want to see it for myself, just once…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that she mentions it… America probably does feel out of reach to a lot of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We could go there someday, in lieu of our canceled international race…
choice_data_list: But you realize it's mostly dirt in America though, right?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huh… Dirt?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Manhattan… The holidays… Dirt. You mean races?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But I wasn't talking about… racing abroad…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um, was that a… joke?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's a relief. Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I want to go sightseeing in Manhattan, not compete there. I'd try one of those non-alcoholic fizz cocktails, and spot celebrities from afar…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even her dream sounds normal. I get to spend this quiet holiday witnessing Manhattan Cafe's true nature.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I want to go sightseeing in Manhattan, not compete there. I'd try one of those non-alcoholic fizz cocktails, and spot celebrities from afar…
choice_data_list: You want to go celebrity spotting?
You want to go celebrity spotting?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm slightly… curious… I'd like to see the brightest stars in the place that shares my name.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Don't worry… Even if I were right next to them, there's no way anyone would notice me staring.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I've always been told I don't have much of a presence. No one would know I was there…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No one at all…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, a group wearing Umamusume caps passes by in front of the open cafe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At this point, Manhattan Cafe is a famous runner in her own right. It'd be a hassle if she got swarmed by fans…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: There's no need to worry, Trainer. No one… is going to notice me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Because… I'm a shadow…

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Wait, isn't that Manhattan Cafe over there?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Hey, you're right. She looks like she's having a blast!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No one is going to notice me… No one…

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: And it looks like she's with someone! Hey, they seem kinda close, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Maybe they're out for a festive meal?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No one… is going to notice me. No one… at all.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, she's red as an apple.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: She's so cute when she's blushing! And I thought I couldn't be a bigger fan!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: They've… noticed me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When you're as famous as Manhattan Cafe, it gets tough to lay low. At this point, she's already a celebrity.
